description: This PHP source file defines the Ec2Client class within the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides methods to interact with Amazon EC2 services, including operation descriptions and method signatures for various EC2 API calls.

classes.name: Aws\Ec2\Ec2Client
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon EC2, providing methods for each EC2 API action.

methods.description: Accepts a VPC peering connection request.
